jobs.occupation: Senior Manager New Opportunities Development (m/f/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Fachschule) - Projektmanagement)
jobs.description:
Your responsibilitiesThe New Opportunities Development Team scouts opportunities for EIT Health to engage in collaborative project proposals, diversifying the organisation’s portfolio of grant-funded projects. The Team leads efforts to build strong proposals and bids across a variety of funding instruments, ensuring opportunities are pursued, structured and developed from early ideas into concrete concepts with a high chance of award by the relevant funding bodies

EIT Health delivers a portfolio of collaborative projects, supported by diversity of funding sources. To ensure a steady pipeline of new opportunities EIT Health is recruiting a Senior Manager, New Opportunities Development. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues in the New Opportunities Development Unit under the Director of Community and Stakeholders Engagement and transversally with relevant business units at EIT Health that have potential to engage in EU funded projects. This role is not about inventing or delivering the underlying innovation itself, but about designing the structures, partnerships and funding pathways that allow others' innovations to be developed, tested and scaled through European collaborative projects. You will scout and prioritise funding opportunities (EU or national grants, philanthropic foundations, tenders), design new project applications, manage the end-to-end proposal development process, ensuring alignment with business needs target financing schemes.
If you have a track record of orchestrating securing EU funded projects, as a consortium architect or proposed lead, experience in raising philanthropic funding, and the drive to turn bold ideas into concrete implementation plans, we want to hear from you.
Role responsibilities:
• Proactively scout for funding opportunities (European, national, private philanthropic) in collaboration with the relevant internal delivery and support teams and EIT Health’s ecosystem engagement staff.
• Support the prioritisation of EIT Health’s and its partners’ engagement in different opportunities, keeping a consolidated map of the funding pipeline and facilitating the relevant internal endorsement and approval processes for participation in grant applications.
• Lead and coordinate proposal development with different functions in the organisation, including project conceptualisation, proposal writing, budget preparation and consortium partner engagement.
• Act as the connective layer between innovators, funders and implementing teams, ensuring ideas are translated into fundable, well-structured project frameworks.
• Collaborate with external stakeholders (such as higher education institutions, research agencies, small and large companies, policy bodies, network organisations, etc.) to build collaborative consortia for joint proposals and bids, including leading on negotiations and alignment on roles, responsibilities and resources.
• Plan the transfer of awarded project proposals to the implementing units, including via administrative and contracting support.
• Maintain repositories, logs and dashboards of the opportunities pipeline and raise internal visibility of proposals under development.
• Collaborate closely with all business units at EIT Health to secure buy-in in proposals in the pipeline (asset management, profit growth, delivery, communications, stakeholder engagement, operations and finance functions) within the wider team and the overarching EIT Health organisation.
• Support post-project review, for internal learning.

Your skills & knowledge
• Master's degree or higher in business administration, innovation management, life sciences, engineering, or a related field, or substantial relevant experience.
• Outstanding stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across multidisciplinary and multinational teams and engage individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and interests through strong interpersonal skills, persuasion and negotiation aptitude.
• Deep understanding of what funding agencies and evaluators look for, including how to align proposal narratives, budgets and work plans with funder priorities and evaluation criteria. Proven ability to act as an orchestrator/facilitator of multi-stakeholder innovation projects, rather than as a technical contributor or inventor—translating others' ideas and technologies into fundable, structured project proposals
• Experience designing innovation support models, frameworks or programme structures (e.g., accelerators, funding calls, matchmaking mechanisms) rather than conducting the underlying research or technology development.
• Strong background in structuring and negotiating proposals as a project architect - defining scope, work packages, partner roles, governance rols, negotiating consortium agreements, partner contributions and funding terms, rather than contributing technical/scientific content.
• Demonstrated experience with European, national, public or private project applications, management and reporting processes, as well as knowledge of relevant European, national, public and private (e.g. philanthropic) innovation funding schemes.
• Proven experience with the EU Funding and Tenders Portal, with the ability to manage the proposal process independently.
• Familiarity with support tools that streamline proposal development (e.g., AI-assisted drafting tools, budget templates, consortium/partner databases, project management or CRM platforms).
• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in complex and innovative environments, cross culturally in an international public-private context.
• Ability to operate both on a strategic and operational level with a clear customer service mindset and in an autonomous and agile manner under a remote-first, fast-paced environment.

ABOUT THE ROLEThis role owns ERC's development assurance processes: how requirements, architecture, validation and verification evidence are produced, traced and released across UAS, system, equipment, item and software level.
You define the framework and make it work on live programmes. Much of the job happens in conversation, so you will spend your time with the engineering teams rather than with documents alone. Your closest counterparts are our Configuration Manager, System Safety and the other teams who apply the process every day.

• Confident use of requirements management tooling for cross-level traceability
• No hesitation in walking up to people you have not met, asking how they work and getting them on board
• A technical degree in aerospace, mechanical or electrical engineering, and fluent English

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides

jobs.occupation: Postdoc | InVivo Vascular Remodeling in Pulmonary Fibrosis and COPD (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
At Boehringer Ingelheim, we are committed to transforming the lives of patients suffering from severe pulmonary diseases. We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Postdoctoral Scientist to join our Vascular Health Cluster within Innovation & Research (I&R).
This position focuses on understanding the role of the pulmonary vasculature in chronic lung diseases, particularly pulmonary fibrosis (PF) and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). While epithelial injury has long been considered a key driver of disease progression, growing evidence highlights the pulmonary endothelium as a critical regulator of vascular remodeling, inflammation, tissue homeostasis, and fibrosis. Aberrant endothelial responses contribute to vascular dysfunction, increased permeability, altered angiogenesis, and pathological tissue remodeling.
As a postdoctoral researcher, you will drive the development of innovative in vivo models and advanced imaging approaches to investigate vascular remodeling and identify new opportunities for therapeutic intervention and drug triaging
Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com
Postdoc: This Position is limited for 2 years.
To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.
Tasks & responsibilities

- One of your key responsibilities will be to establish, characterize and validate novel in vivo models of pulmonary vascular pathologies, including aberrant angiogenesis, pathological vascular sprouting and endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndoMT).
- You will investigate vascular remodeling in pulmonary fibrosis and COPD and define robust, disease-relevant endpoints for mechanistic and pharmacological studies.
- In regard to quantitative vascular assessment, you will develop readouts for aberrant angiogenesis, vascular thickening, pulmonary vascular volume and structural changes within the pulmonary vasculature.
- Moreover, you will apply and further develop high-resolution micro-computed tomography (µCT) of isolated lungs and image-based quantification pipelines for vascular analysis.
- In addition, you will identify and evaluate tissue-based and circulating biomarkers associated with pulmonary vascular pathology and translate preclinical findings into novel therapeutic concepts.
- Furthermore, you will collaborate with internal and external experts, present your findings at scientific meetings and contribute to mentoring students and junior scientists where appropriate.

Requirements

- PhD in Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacology, Veterinary Medicine, Imaging Sciences or a related discipline.
- FELASA-B certification or an equivalent qualification that enables independent work with laboratory animals, together with hands-on experience in animal models.
- Experience with µCT imaging and/or advanced image analysis methods; experience with computational imaging or independent programming will be an advantage.
- Solid knowledge of molecular and cellular biology techniques, including flow cytometry (FACS), Western blotting, ELISA, PCR/qPCR, and protein and RNA analysis.
- Knowledge of pulmonary diseases, particularly pulmonary fibrosis and/or COPD; expertise in vascular biology, endothelial cell biology, angiogenesis or fibrosis research will be an advantage.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in written and spoken English; German language skills will be a strong advantage.

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers and businesses to grow, discover, and create.

IntelliJ IDEA revolutionized the Java development tool market back in 2001, becoming the first IDE to offer automated code refactoring. It continues to drive innovation in software development, making thousands of programmers more productive every day. In addition to Java, IntelliJ IDEA includes various development tools for other prominent languages such as Ruby, Groovy, Scala, Python, JavaScript, Objective-C, PHP, and Kotlin.

About the team

The IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate team is responsible for supporting a wide range of enterprise frameworks, data-access stacks, and application servers in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate. This includes technologies such as Spring (including Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, and others), Jakarta EE, Quarkus, Micronaut, various reactive and data-access libraries, and popular application servers like Tomcat, WildFly, and Jetty. We ensure that developers can easily create, configure, run, debug, and observe their backend applications directly from the IDE. As part of the Ultimate QA group, you’ll work across different areas of the product – frameworks, HTTP client, persistence tooling, and application servers – and collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other QA teams to deliver a smooth end-to-end experience for JVM backend developers.

We’re now looking for a QA Automation Engineer to join the IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate QA team and help ensure the quality of a product that our customers and software engineers around the world rely on daily. You’ll work alongside QA engineers to design and set up our automation process for end-to-end tests, as well as implement and automate test scenarios that catch issues before they reach our users.

What you’ll do

Core responsibilities:

- Design, develop, and maintain multi-platform and environmental (Linux, Windows, macOS, Docker, WSL) automated test scenarios.
- Expand test coverage for new and existing functionality.
- Debug and troubleshoot test failures.
- Improve existing automation based on team feedback and reduce test flakiness.
- Track quality metrics, including testing coverage, failure rate, and flakiness.
- Contribute to frameworks and tools with product-specific extensions as needed.
- Help the team monitor test execution results and investigate failures.
- Participate in release quality assessments.
- Collaborate with QA and developers to define test strategies.
- Do manual QA activities when needed.
- Participate in the test documentation creation.
- Improve domain-specific test infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines within your team’s scope.
- Share automation best practices with the team.
- Work with the tooling team to adopt new frameworks and practices.

What we’re looking for

Required skills:

- Proven experience in test automation.
- Solid programming skills in Kotlin/Java.
- Experience with test frameworks like JUnit or TestNG.
- Familiarity with build tools, like Maven and Gradle.
- An understanding of software testing principles and methodologies.
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools (TeamCity or similar).
- Experience with reporting tools (Allure or others).
- Version control experience (Git).
- Proficiency in spoken and written English.
- Responsibility, self-discipline, and self-learning skills.
- Strong teamwork skills.
- The ability to work independently, creatively, and on your own initiative.

Nice to have:

- Experience testing developer tools, IDEs, and desktop applications.
- Familiarity with JVM Frameworks (Spring or Jakarta) and databases.

**Why join JetBrains?** 

- Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
- Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
- Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
- Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
- Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
- Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
- Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible. 
- Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
- Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.
- Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
- Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer (Qodana Core) (m/f/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

We build Qodana to bring the intelligence of JetBrains IDEs directly into the CI/CD pipeline, helping engineering teams spot security flaws, license issues, and bugs before they ever reach production. As AI-assisted coding grows, the need for deep, static code analysis is more critical than ever.

In this role, you’ll join our Qodana Core team to expand our static analysis engine and design new algorithms for complex, inter-procedural code analysis. You will have direct ownership over how we configure and orchestrate these analyses across different environments. You’ll collaborate closely with other JetBrains compiler and IDE teams, directly influencing how development teams worldwide maintain code quality and adopt AI safely.

Day to day, you will:

- Design and implement new static analysis checks, rules, and inter-procedural analysis algorithms.
- Extend Qodana’s capabilities in critical areas like license compliance, security, and vulnerability detection.
- Optimize how code analysis runs, configure execution paths, and orchestrate performance based on project context.
- Build and refine CI/CD integrations to make Qodana easy to adopt across different development workflows.
- Collaborate with compiler and IDE teams across JetBrains to share insights and align analysis engines.
- Take ownership of features from early concept to release, gathering feedback and iterating to make them better.

What you’ll bring

- A deep curiosity about code structure, compilers, and how static analysis works.
- A proactive mindset, not waiting for permission to fix a broken process or improve a system.
- Strong collaboration skills and a readiness to support your technical ideas with clear, logical reasoning.
- Comfort working in a distributed team across different countries and time zones.
- A focus on quality over quick fixes, valuing long-term maintainability in your work.
- Experience with developer tooling, static analysis, application security, or LLM-based applications would be a plus. Familiarity with languages and ecosystems beyond the JVM – such as C++, Rust, JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, .NET, or Go – would also be valuable.

What you’ll need

- Deep, practical knowledge of JVM development (such as Kotlin or Java).
- Experience designing and implementing complex algorithms or handling performance-critical backend architectures.
- Fluent communication skills in English to collaborate with team members globally.

What success looks like

- **First 3 months:** You will get familiar with the Qodana codebase and the IntelliJ Platform architecture, delivering your first set of analysis rules and integrations.
- **First 6 months:** You will take full ownership of specific analysis features, collaborating with neighboring teams to design robust solutions for complex codebases.
- **Long term:** You will help shape the technical direction of Qodana Core, continuously raising the bar for static analysis performance and developer experience.

Why join JetBrains?

- Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
- Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
- Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
- Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
- Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
- Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
- Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
- Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Structural Biology of Protein Kinase Regulation by RNA Helicases (Biochemiker/in)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network.

Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.

How cells communicate with their environment via cell-cell interactions and by growth factors is a key question in the molecular life sciences, including tumor biology. Wnt signaling plays an important role in embryonic development and cancer.

In the Division of Molecular Embryology (headed by Prof. Dr. Christof Niehrs), we study mechanisms of Wnt pathway regulation. To this end, we identify developmental control genes, investigate their biological role and biochemical mode of action, and examine how the genes are regulated.

To strengthen our team, we are seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Postdoc in Structural Biology of Protein Kinase Regulation by RNA Helicases.

Your Tasks

The Niehrs laboratory has identified DEAD-box RNA helicases as novel activators of protein kinases. In the context of Wnt-β-catenin signaling, DDX3 and CK1 cooperate and are both oncogenes. Understanding their regulatory interaction is therefore of considerable interest for the development of novel cancer therapeutics.

To unravel the mode of action whereby DDX3X activates CK1, you will solve and characterize the 3D structure of a DDX3-CK. To that end, you will produce recombinant DDX3X and CK1 proteins, purify and characterize their complexes using biochemical and biophysical methods. You will subject the kinase complexes to structural analysis using cryo-EM SPA or X-ray crystallography.

This project will be carried out in close collaboration between the laboratories of Prof. Dr. Irmgard Sinning at the University of Heidelberg and Prof. Dr. Christof Niehrs at the DKFZ. The postdoc will primarily work in the lab of Prof. Sinning and will receive training in a broad range of state-of-the-art techniques in structural biochemistry and biophysics.  

Techniques employed include recombinant protein production, FPLC, Western blotting, automated protein crystallization, single-particle cryo-EM (SPA), advanced X-ray structure determination using synchrotron radiation, AI-assisted protein modeling, hydrogen–deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX-MS), microscale thermophoresis (MST), and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC).

Your Profile

Applicants should hold a master's degree in molecular life sciences (e.g., biochemistry, biotechnology, molecular biology) with a background in recombinant protein work and/or structural biology. The applicant should be able to pursue research projects independently as well as in collaborations. Good written and oral command of English is essential.

Please submit a single PDF file including a CV (Germans: copies of Abitur & Masters degree), a cover letter stating your research and career interests, certificates, your expected availability date, and a list of publications, and attach two letters of reference.

Incomplete applications will not be considered or acknowledged.  

References:
Cruciat et al. (2013). RNA helicase DDX3 is a regulatory subunit of casein kinase 1 in Wnt-β-catenin signaling. Science 339, 1436-1441.

Fatti et al. (2023) DEAD-box RNA helicases act as nucleotide exchange factors for Casein Kinase 2. Science Signalling 16, eabp8923

Hirth et al. (2024) DEAD-box RNA helicases are pervasive protein kinase interactors and activators. Genome Res. 34, 952-966.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Possibility of part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being
- Develop your full potential: access to the DKFZ International Postdoc Program and DKFZ Career Service with targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Prof. Dr. Christof Niehrs
Phone: +49 (0)6221-42 4690

Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.

Application Deadline: September 9, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.
